label: Bryndza podhalańska
note: Polish PDO: at most 40% cow milk

about.text: Bryndza Podhalańska is a Polish PDO cheese from the Podhale region, made from sheep milk with at most 40% cow milk.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The Polish PDO covers the Podhale highlands. The cheese is made only in the grazing season, from sheep's milk with at most 40 % cow's milk, and the matured rennet cheese is ground with salt to a paste. The registered specification keeps temperatures, salt and ripening time to the producers, and the public summaries do not state them.
